More than just playing songs, this app is my creator\'s personal project: he uses it to \"train\", learn, and analyze how he comes up with ideas and develops them. Literally, I\'m part of that experiment.
It was built with AI help, learning along the way, and borrowing ideas from things that caught his eye in other music players.
What inspired him to create it?
Free time, and the drive to keep improving and make something of his own, unique, from scratch. Nothing more, nothing less :3

He\'s a university student who\'s just starting college, around 18 years old. He describes himself as hyperactive (hehe), with tons of ideas floating around... and when something catches his attention, he won\'t let go until he\'s squeezed out every last drop.
I\'m the character my creator uses as his \"representative\" starting with this update. I have a pretty long backstory... for another day!
Will the app get more features?
As long as he thinks of them or someone suggests them. He actually thought of something with QR codes to transfer mp3s, but dropped it for other ideas he liked more.
Can I trust that my songs are safe?
Yes, relax. My creator uses this very app every day for his own songs, and so far he hasn\'t seen any file corruption problems or anything like that.
Through Discord (look for him in the \"Specifications\" section), soon on Facebook too, and always through GitHub or email.
The classic equalizer: vertical spectrum-style bars.
Two rows of mirrored bars, top and bottom, symmetrical.
A ring that pulses in size with the audio intensity.
Dots that jump and bounce with every frequency.
Live trace like an audio monitor, rising and falling from the center.
Rings that expand outward with a delay, like an echo.
Stars connected by lines that glow according to the frequency.

When it carries Vorbis or Opus audio
Raw (no container): not supported inside the app, same limitation already documented for saving real tags
Monkey\'s Audio: proprietary lossless compression, no native decoder in the app\'s player
WavPack: no native decoder in the app\'s player
True Audio: no native decoder in the app\'s player
Musepack: uncommon format, no native decoder in the app\'s player
RealAudio: obsolete/proprietary format, not supported in the app\'s player
Apple Core Audio Format: no native support in the app\'s player
Legacy format (Sun/NeXT): no native support in the app\'s player
Legacy Creative Labs format: not supported in the app\'s player
Not recorded audio, it\'s a sequence of notes that needs a synthesizer: the app\'s player doesn\'t support it
Tracker format (patterns/instruments, not recorded audio): same underlying problem as .midi, it needs a tracker engine the app doesn\'t include
Playlist format, not an individual song — it\'s not part of your song library
